name: Shokushu Ouji no Nikuyome Sagashi ~Haha to Kyoudai no Owaranai Zecchou Jigoku~
original_name: 触手王子の肉嫁探し～母と姉弟の終わらない絶頂地獄～
source:
Even after losing her husband at a young age, the mother, Fuyuko, has continued to live happily and with the children he left behind.
The children, who are not sisters the same age but actually siblings, support their mother and live together in harmony as a family.

One day on the weekend, the three of them enjoyed a casual lunch at a small family restaurant near their home.
Before leaving, Fuyuko gone to the bathroom to fix up her makeup.
Unfortunately, it was a small bathroom with no mirror in the sink.
After entering the stall, she realized also that she didn't have a hand mirror in her makeup bag.

With no other choice, she started applying makeup while looking at the black screen of her smartphone, but suddenly, a tentacle reached out from the phone...

translation:
即使在年轻时失去了丈夫，母亲冬子仍然和他留下的孩子们一起幸福地生活。
孩子们不是同龄的姐妹，而是真正的兄弟姐妹，他们赡养母亲，一家人和睦相处。

周末的一天，三人在家附近的一家小家庭餐馆享用了一顿休闲午餐。
离开前，冬子去卫生间补了妆。
不幸的是，这是一个小浴室，水槽里没有镜子。
进了摊位后，她又发现自己的化妆包里没有手镜。

无奈之下，她一边看着黑屏的手机开始化妆，却突然，一根触手从手机里伸了出来……
